title: Nexus PackImportResponse
description: Response for POST /v1/daemon/worlds/:world_id/kb/pack/import (V1.152 P0 DF-77). Per-atom-type summary counts plus a details list, the quarantined atoms of an import run (v1.191 P1 T10) and the bounded payload of the read-only review arm. On the review arm the counts are zero and `details` is empty; the batch's atoms are in `review`.

details.description: Per-atom outcome details (entry or relation). A quarantined atom is also reported here as `rejected`, so the retained counts stay complete.

quarantined.description: Atoms this import held outside the KB stores (v1.191 P1 T10, holder-governance.md §6): ids, reasons and original wire governance. These atoms are absent from every ordinary read, export, search and compute path until a mapping adopts them.

review.description: Present on the read-only review arm: one import batch's bounded quarantined atoms with their immutable original KE JSON.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason (e.g. why rejected, skipped or quarantined).

quarantine_id.description: Stable qrn_ id of the quarantine row.

batch_id.description: The import batch that first held this atom; pass it to review_import.

reason.description: Why the atom is held: its foreign holder id is unmapped, or its disclosure is outside the native vocabulary.

original_owner.description: The atom's original wire owner, exactly as the pack carried it.

original_disclosure.description: The atom's original wire disclosure, exactly as the pack carried it.

truncated.description: Whether the batch held more atoms than the review bound returns.

atoms.description: Up to the review bound atoms, stable-id order, each with its immutable original KE JSON.

original_entry.description: The immutable original wire KnowledgeEntry JSON, verbatim as the pack carried it. Isolated local review only — never a knowledge view.
